test_title: PYST 201: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 26th Nov, 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Nimesh is the only brother of Meghna. Surbhi is the daughter of Nimesh. Meghna and Neha are sisters. Mani is the son of Karan, who is the husband of Meghna. How is Mani related to Surbhi?
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cdd0b30cffaf954e65ff899730e11e9e4ceb2b8a3106f0f1cf7dc6cc2718c84.png] 

Given:

1) Nimesh is the only brother of Meghna.

2) Surbhi is the daughter of Nimesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db1a743511b1499f894effcc00b17fbb9d77024f82965619732b9115b3da782e.png] 

3) Meghna and Neha are sisters.

4) Mani is the son of __**Karan, who**__ is the husband of Meghna.

 
• Here Karan is the husband of Meghna.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fadc966eba21cafd07a3f8b2b0cbd8991a31f4443c9fd50180c331d4706ccb42.png] 

Thus, Mani is the "Cousin brother" of the Surbhi.

Hence, "Cousin brother" is the correct answer.
